attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Upgrading Font Awesome from 6.x to 7.0.0 renames/removes many icon classes (e.g. fa-edit→fa-pen-to-square, fa-times→fa-xmark, fa-trash-alt→fa-trash, fa-arrows-alt→fa-up-down-left-right) across dozens of core admin views, so any theme/module in the ecosystem that overrides these views, extends them, or references the old FA5/6 icon classes directly (not through the shared partials) will silently show missing/broken icons after upgrade, and a broad vendor asset replacement always carries some risk of subtle CSS/JS regressions even though the C# config change looks additive."}
